desc:
Would You Rather: Pop Star Outfit Tower 💖!
Choose a door and build your pop star look one step at a time 🎀

Will you become a cute idol, a stylish superstar, or end up with a total fashion disaster? 😭

Every choice gives you something new:
🔥 trendy clothes, hairstyles, and accessories
💀 or a silly item that will DESTROY your look

Reach the top and prove you can create the best pop star outfit ever ✨

❤️ Like the game + join the group for extra perks
